title: CSKA are VTB League champions
description: CSKA - Unics 89-81 CSKA claimed VTB League title. They beat Unics in Game 3 in Moscow to complete the sweep of the Finals. Unics trailed by 11 points after 3 quarters before a 15-12 run in the last quarter cut the deficit to 81-89 at the end of the game. It was a great evening for Georgian forward Tornike Shengelia (206-91, agency: Wasserman) who led his team to a victory scoring 19 points and 7 rebounds. American Will Clyburn (201-90, college: Iowa St.) helped adding 18 points and 5 assists, while Daniel Hackett (193-G-87, college: USC) had 17 points and was named the MVP. The best for the losing side was American forward John Brown III (203-92, college: High Point) with a double-double by scoring 25 points and 11 rebounds and the other American import guard Jamar Smith (191-87, college: S.Indiana, agency: Inception Sports) scored 17 points.
